# Table 12: RQ4 RCAEval-C decoy grid (H4c)

RCAEval-C on RE2, oracle alert; decoys planted in [-1800, 300] s around the alert (04 §5.2); the AI cells run on the 90-case subset (Case set column). 95% cluster-bootstrap intervals in brackets; a value without one says so (04 §8); failed, timed-out, no-alert, rejected and unranked runs count as misses. Outcomes counts all the group's rows per run outcome (03 §13.3): its fault-case runs and, in an experiment with normal windows, one row per normal window, so it can exceed Fault-case runs. Avg@5, MRR, Fine AC@k and Rerank@1 are listed by these experiments and are in each one's summary.json, but not tabulated here. Protocol of each experiment: see Sources.
